ck_item_availability_count.name: ck_item_availability_count
ck_item_availability_count.value: ("item_availability"."daily_limit" is null and "item_availability"."remaining" is null and "item_availability"."remaining_on" is null) or ("item_availability"."daily_limit" is not null and "item_availability"."daily_limit" >= 1 and coalesce("item_availability"."remaining", 0) between 0 and "item_availability"."daily_limit")

ck_menus_access.name: ck_menus_access
ck_menus_access.value: ("menus"."access" = 'public' and "menus"."password_hash" is null) or ("menus"."access" = 'password' and "menus"."password_hash" is not null)

ux_stories_collection_stop.name: ux_stories_collection_stop
ux_stories_collection_stop.where: "stories"."collection" is not null and "stories"."chapter_no" is not null

ck_stories_stop.name: ck_stories_stop
ck_stories_stop.value: "stories"."chapter_no" is null or ("stories"."collection" is not null and "stories"."chapter_no" >= 1)
